charges.label: Weight component (₹6.00 per kg of billed weight)
charges.quote: a weight component of ₹6.00 per kg of billed weight

charges.label: Distance component (₹2.00 per km of booked lane distance)
charges.quote: a distance component of ₹2.00 per km of the booked lane distance

charges.label: Cold chain premium (20% on the freight charge)
charges.quote: Consignments booked as cold chain travel in refrigerated vehicles and carry a premium of 20% on the freight charge (the sum of the weight and distance components).

document_rules.rule: The c-note number quoted on each invoice line must correspond to a Customer booking; lines that cannot be matched to a booking are not payable until reconciled.
The Carrier may issue credit notes correcting earlier invoices; a credit note references the original c-note number and the invoice it corrects.
A credit note must cover the full corrected amount.
Payment is due 21 days from invoice date.

ambiguities.description: The contract states only standard service is offered under this agreement; no rate is given for express service. Shipments with service_level=express are outside the scope of this rate card and pricing is undetermined.

notes: Freight = weight component (₹6/kg billed weight) + distance component (₹2/km) per §1; only standard service offered (§2); cold_chain flag adds a 20% premium on the sum of the weight+distance components (§3), no premium named for fragile or residential handling so none is charged. No accessorial schedule beyond §1/§3 and no explicit closed-list statement, so accessorials_policy.closed_list=false. No invoice-level volume discount is stated. Ambiguity: contract offers only standard service (§2) with no express rate, so service_level=express shipments have undetermined pricing under this agreement.
